No numbers here are new measurements -- every field cites commit c44905a18 and docs/prefill-needle-theories-20260724.md THEORY 3. extra/llm_research/prefill/prefill_causal_tile_skip_promotion_gate.py reads this file; it does not embed thresholds/results inline so the gate and the evidence stay independently auditable.
exactness_argument: A fully-masked KV tile is a mathematical no-op: weight==0 everywhere and old_m==new_m so alpha==1 (see amd_attention_abi.expand_native_row_softmax_repack); the dynamic bound only reduces trip count for waves whose causal mask already zeroed those tiles, it does not change which elements are summed.
